# Staycay Management

> Exceptional homes. Exceptionally managed. Staycay Management is a specialist manager of high-quality holiday homes in the Peak District, with further homes across Derbyshire and South Yorkshire. It manages 75+ holiday homes and has operated for three years.

## For property owners
- [For Owners](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/for-owners/): why owners choose Staycay
- [Full Management](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/services/full-management/): flagship service; guests, housekeeping, maintenance, pricing and reporting handled
- [Bookings & Revenue Management](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/services/bookings-revenue-management/): pricing, listings and bookings for owners who look after the home themselves
- [How it works](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/how-it-works/)
- [Request a property appraisal](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/property-appraisal/): free, response within 48 hours
- Management fees are not published; they are set out in a proposal after appraisal.

## For guests
- [Our Homes](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/our-homes/): curated collection, booked directly on Staycay's booking site
- [Millstone Barn, Hathersage, Hope Valley](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/our-homes/millstone-barn/): sleeps 8
- [Curlew Cottage, Edale](https://www.staycaymanagement.co.uk/our-homes/curlew-cottage/): sleeps 4
